summary: Tested multi-branch feature end-to-end. Backend: 28/28 tests pass (13 new branch tests + 15 legacy). Frontend: kiosk/monitor BranchPicker, admin branches CRUD, dashboard branch selector + overview, settings split (general + branch), operator branch dropdown all working. Fixed 1 critical JSX syntax error in Admin.jsx (unclosed <div>) that was breaking the entire frontend compilation.
action_items: OPTIONAL/PRE-EXISTING: Login page redirects to /admin regardless of the intended target URL. Visiting /operator when logged out → /login → after auth → /admin (not /operator). Consider preserving `from` location via react-router state so users can be redirected back to their intended page.

OPTIONAL: In Kiosk & Monitor, clicking the branch badge clears localStorage and re-shows BranchPicker; however when only 1 active branch exists, BranchPicker auto-selects it immediately (by design). This means the ganti-cabang UX has no visible effect in single-branch deployments. Consider showing a confirmation or listing even a single branch to make the action explicit.
critical_code_review_comments:
FIXED: /app/frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx Dashboard tab had an unclosed
around lines 196-204 causing a JSX SyntaxError that broke the entire frontend build. Added missing
after the Reset Antrian button.
Consider splitting Admin.jsx (560+ lines) into smaller components (Dashboard, BranchesTab, ServicesTab, CountersTab, SettingsTab) — currently a single monolithic file.
Admin.jsx line 76 has an unused eslint-disable directive (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps) — cleanup recommended.
server.py BranchInput uses forward reference List['PromoItem'] before PromoItem is defined; works only because it's evaluated lazily. Move PromoItem definition above BranchInput for clarity.
seed_data_creation: Tests create temporary TEST_Cabang_B / TEST_UI_Cabang branches and delete them on teardown. Kantor Pusat is left intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/{backend_test.py,test_branches.py}. Run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/ -n 0` (sequential; xdist loadscope in pytest.ini causes state races for cross-test fixtures in test_branches). Multi-branch isolation verified via API (services/counters/tickets/state/stats/reset all scoped by branch_id; WS broadcasts include branch_id in both 'update' and 'call' events). Frontend verified for Kiosk/Monitor BranchPicker, Admin branches CRUD tab + branch selector on Dashboard/Layanan/Loket, split Settings (Umum + Pengaturan Cabang w/ ticker + promo media), Operator 3-select layout (Cabang/Loket/Layanan). No breaking issues remain.
rca of the issue: Critical JSX SyntaxError in Admin.jsx blocked all frontend routes with 'Compiled with problems' overlay. Root cause: when the Reset Antrian button and branch-select were wrapped in an inner flex container inside the outer flex-wrap header container, the outer container's closing was missing. Fixed by adding the missing after the inner flex closes and before the stat cards grid opens.
